features: Independent manual player control and Sell restored; default on for first migration, persisted afterward
Five selection-only CALL sites managed as a conflict/rollback group
Current-player switching disabled at UI and Runtime; forged requests rejected
Native constructors and existing event queue transport retained; no local direct-executor backend
limitations: Synthetic worlds and Win32 substitutes; not full Windows game execution.
Native constructors and shipped DLL execute; hit testing and selected interfaces use fixtures.
No two-peer netplay verification; admission/queue submission is not proof of remote execution.
